race.comment: BLUE AND GOLD (2) resumes for his second run (and second campaign) having run a great race in Listed company on debut at Caulfield. He's trialled well since and finds a nice race to be notching up his maiden win, especially with a couple of key dangers scratching. TURBO SAINT (10) is a well-related Zousain gelding for the McDonald yard, wary of any market support for strong connections off a jumpout placing. FIRM'N'HIGH (11) took on some good races in her maiden campaign and is better placed here fresh off a jumpout win, consider. FORT SUMTER (12) ran on well without the best of luck on debut at Moe. Better for that and should take some holding out here.
